About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

snippet.title: Burnham endures DISASTROUS week as Labour REVOLTS over energy U-TURN
snippet.description:
Labour drew the ire of many this week when they announced that they would proceed with gas drilling at Jackdaw in the North Sea.

The House of Commons became a battlefield as Labour came under fire from all sides, including their own. Tories claimed that their actions still didn't go far enough with many oil and gas fields left unsanctioned, while Labour MPs called out the decision as a betrayal of the party's net zero initiatives.

The announcement even brought the wrath of Commons speaker Lindsay Hoyle who berated the Labour energy Minister, Michael Shanks, over the announcement being made first in the media rather than in the House and then having the Energy Secretary miss the Commons session.

snippet.title: how did japan, with a huge advantage, lose midway? #history #didyouknow #ww2
snippet.description:
In June 1942, Japan showed up to the Battle of Midway with 200 warships, eight aircraft carriers, and over 600 planes. America had three carriers and knew it was outgunned.

So how did Japan walk away having lost four of its best carriers in a single morning?

In this video, we break down exactly what went wrong for Japan at the Battle of Midway — from the cracked codes to the chaos on the carrier decks.

Topics covered in this video:

How Japan assembled its largest naval force ever to lure and destroy the American carrier fleet
The three-part attack plan: the Aleutian feint, the Midway assault, and the carrier ambush
How American codebreakers cracked Japan's communications and knew the entire plan in advance
How America quietly dispatched three carriers to set an ambush northeast of Midway
The fatal decision: Nagumo's order to rearm all planes with bombs mid-battle
The moment Japan's planes finished swapping torpedoes for bombs — and the American carriers appeared
How the bombs and torpedoes piled on Japan's carrier decks triggered catastrophic explosions
Four Japanese carriers sunk in hours. One American carrier lost in the counterattack. Battle over.
Why the Battle of Midway became the turning point of the entire Pacific War
Japan had the numbers. Japan had the plan. But America had the codes — and that changed everything.

snippet.title: 셀프주유소 '이 버튼' 절대 누르지 마세요! 🚨
snippet.description:
셀프주유소에서 가득 주유 중 주유총 손잡이가 첫 번째 '딸깍' 하고 멈추면 이미 연료탱크 안전선(Safe Line)까지 기름이 다 찬 상태입니다.

이때 키오스크 화면에 뜨는 '금액 멈춤(정액)'이나 '리터 멈춤(정량)' 버튼을 눌러 추가 주유(과주유)를 하면 다음과 같은 차량 고장과 금전 손실이 발생합니다.

1. 불필요한 추가 요금 결제 및 주유구 기름 역류 사고 위험
2. 연료탱크 숨구멍 배관 액체 기름 역류로 인한 유증기 필터(활성탄 캐니스터) 침수 고장
3. 엔진 내 유증기 과다 유입으로 인한 엔진 경고등 점등 및 수리비 발생

✅ 올바른 셀프주유소 가득 주유 방법
• 첫 '딸깍' 정지 후 화면에 뜨는 정액·정량 버튼은 절대 누르지 마세요.
• 실수로 버튼을 눌렀더라도 주유기 손잡이만 다시 당기지 않으면 기름은 나오지 않습니다.
• 그대로 주유총을 제자리에 걸면 처음 멈춘 금액만 결제되고 카드 선결제 차액은 자동 취소됩니다.

#셀프주유소 #자동차관리 #운전자필수 #자동차상식 #차량관리

A developing weather system over the Bay of Bengal may intensify into a low-pressure area, with the possibility of further strengthening. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Odisha on Sunday, October 25, for a brief visit to inaugurate the Reserve Bank of India’s data centre at Jatni. The facility has reportedly been built at a cost of ₹170 crore and is described as the country’s second data centre.

Meanwhile, Kartik rituals have begun at the Shree Jagannath Temple in Puri, where the deities are being worshipped in the Radha Damodar Besha. गरीब पत्नी को दो बच्चों के साथ छोड़ गया पति, 8 साल बाद कलेक्टर बनकर लौटा तो… फिर जो हुआ 💔😢

गरीब पत्नी को दो बच्चों के साथ अकेला छोड़कर चला गया पति, लेकिन 8 साल बाद जब वही पति कलेक्टर बनकर अपने गांव लौटा, तो उसके सामने ऐसा सच आया जिसने उसकी जिंदगी बदल दी। 💔😢

यह कहानी है अंजलि की, जिसने अपने पति के सपनों के लिए अपनी खुशियां कुर्बान कर दीं। लेकिन जब उस पर चोरी का झूठा इल्जाम लगाया गया, तब उसके पति ने भी उसका साथ नहीं दिया। मजबूर होकर अंजलि ने अपने दो बच्चों के साथ अकेले जिंदगी की मुश्किलों का सामना किया।

समय बीता और उसका पति कलेक्टर बनकर वापस लौटा। जब उसने अपनी पत्नी और बच्चों को इस हालत में देखा, तो उसे अपनी गलतियों का एहसास हुआ। लेकिन क्या केवल पछतावा करने से टूटे हुए रिश्ते फिर जुड़ सकते हैं? क्या अंजलि अपने पति पर दोबारा भरोसा कर पाएगी?

इस भावुक हिंदी कहानी को अंत तक जरूर देखिए। ❤️

कहानी पसंद आए तो वीडियो को LIKE करें, अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ SHARE करें और ऐसी ही भावुक हिंदी कहानियों के लिए चैनल को SUBSCRIBE करना न भूलें।

आपके अनुसार, क्या अंजलि को अपने पति को दूसरा मौका देना चाहिए? अपनी राय COMMENT में जरूर बताएं।
